title: Another Mallworld dream, this time more vivid and we were interacting
content: I had another mallworld dream, this time it was more detailed, and we were interacting which is rare. We were all dressed like the future and the past. We have jobs and there are offices attached to the mall. I worked in a clothing store. One thing that i remember is the mall is off limits to the outside world and they arent supposed to know about it but we somehow get paid to work here. This time we were having a ton of fun at work, there was music playing and we were dancing while working. The maze goes on forever, and I kept getting lost and other workers had to show me where to go. The name of my store was called Steinbergers. I had an apartment attached to it. The apartment was sort of dilapidated but it was made " homey" Everything was black laquer and shiny, minus the offices attached. Lots of neon and big windows. It seems like this was once abandoned and we were living there. WHAT IS THIS PLACE. I miss it dearly when Im awake.
